ouverture-inscriptions-academie-allemand.title: Applications open for the new free German/English cohort (A1 to B2)
ouverture-inscriptions-academie-allemand.excerpt: Thanks to the support of the IROKO Group and our donors, new free language support sessions are opening online and in Cameroon.
content: WAHHF Foundation announces that applications are open for its next support session for German/English language courses, available free of charge from level A1 to level B2.
This solidarity scheme is aimed at anyone motivated who wishes to build a study or vocational training plan with seriousness and method.
To join a cohort, we invite applicants to first take the free online orientation test, then fill in the single application form.

campagne-sante-prevention-communautaire.title: Health prevention and listening days with rural families
campagne-sante-prevention-communautaire.excerpt: A look back at our mobile outreach for health awareness, free screening and support for mothers.
content: In partnership with local health professionals, WAHHF Foundation volunteers ran a prevention campaign focused on maternal and child health.
Beyond guidance consultations, these meetings give families lasting information on nutrition-related prevention and water hygiene.

reboisement-jeunesse-engagement-ecologiq.title: Young volunteers commit to reforestation and agroecology
reboisement-jeunesse-engagement-ecologiq.excerpt: Planting young seedlings of local species and hands-on soil conservation workshops with partner schools.
content: Because protecting the environment is inseparable from the well-being of communities, WAHHF involves pupils and students in creating local tree nurseries.
Each tree planted is followed up by a group of pupils, combining ecological responsibility with learning about agronomy.
